issues.on_page: Miscellaneous 101,743 (Road 100,272; General 1,071; NonMajor 400); Statement of Activities p2 shows Capital Grants and Contributions 100,000 and general Miscellaneous 1,743
issues.issue: About 100,000 of this line is reported as a capital grant/contribution on the Statement of Activities. The printed label says Miscellaneous, so other is defensible, but the line could arguably be a grant or contribution. The grantor isn't printed, and the extractor flagged it for review.

issues.on_page: Local 55,902 (Exhibit H); the same 55,902 is printed as Inheritance Tax on Exhibit D p4
issues.issue: The category comes from a cross-reference to Exhibit D, not from this row's label, and the item has no computed field. FY2024 handled the same line differently (it relabelled the line "Inheritance tax" and set split_from and computed). The amount is right, but the two years are inconsistent.
